name: rpg-story-life
description: MMORPG de texto em tempo real - Inspirado em AQWorlds, DragonFable, Adventure Quest

scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm ci --include=dev && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:admin
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
